payload.name: Ensure per-person item evidence for activity-enhancement questions
payload.description: When a question asks what ways, methods, or items multiple people use to enhance or improve an activity, verify each named person has concrete item evidence and run targeted per-person preference/event searches if one has only generic activity memories.
content: When the question asks what ways or items people use to enhance/improve an activity, treat it as requiring concrete enhancers for each named person, not merely the activity itself.

After retrieval, map evidence to each named person. If a person has only generic activity memories, run a supplementary hybrid search with that person's name, the activity, and common enhancement-item terms (e.g., scents, music, equipment, atmosphere, 'prefers', 'purchased'), including preference and event memory kinds.
Do not answer until every named person either has a concrete enhancement item in evidence or a targeted per-person search has been attempted.

solves: The failure occurred because a multi-person 'how do they enhance X' question was answered from generic activity memories, missing one person's concrete enhancement items stored in preference/event memories. The reusable rule is to verify per-person evidence of concrete enhancers and run targeted per-person item searches before answering. It applies to future questions asking what ways/methods/items multiple people use to enhance or improve an activity; it does not apply to questions seeking only general activities without specific enhancement items.
